title: FixerPassV1
description: Sidecar produced by the implementer agent at the end of each fixer queue pass. Written atomically via tmp+rename to ${RUN_DIR}/fixer-pass-<class>.json.

class.description: Which autofix class this pass handled.

applied.description: Findings that were successfully applied in this pass.

failed.description: Findings that could not be applied (stale evidence, verify_cmd failure, or other error). Each entry MUST include a 'reason' field.

advisory.description: Findings noted for human review only; not attempted by the implementer.

FixerEntry.description: A single finding entry in the sidecar (applied or advisory).

finding_num.description: 1-based index of the finding in the original review queue.

file_line.description: File path and line number in the form 'path/to/file:NN'.

title.description: Short human-readable title of the finding.

reason.description: Optional explanatory note (e.g. what the fix did, why it was skipped). Required in failed entries; optional in applied/advisory.

FailedFixerEntry.description: A single finding entry in the sidecar that failed to apply. 'reason' is required.

finding_num.description: 1-based index of the finding in the original review queue.

file_line.description: File path and line number in the form 'path/to/file:NN'.

title.description: Short human-readable title of the finding.

reason.description: Explanation of why this finding failed (e.g. 'stale evidence', 'verify_cmd exited 1').
